instruction: The party night poster was deleted. Please retrieve it from Trash and move it to the Pictures folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp ] && echo 'File exists.' || echo 'File does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires recovering file from Trash and moving it to Pictures folder. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Pictures/poster_party_night.webp. Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter.
metadata.verification: Verified that evaluator checks file location in Pictures folder instead of Desktop. Task requires recovery and relocation to a standard user directory.
